name: Chart - Water Quality
query:
SELECT
    log_timestamp AS "Timestamp",
    hydroponic_system As "HydrponicSystem",
    measured_ph AS "pH",
    measured_ec_mscm AS "EC",
    water_temperature_c AS "Temp"
FROM
    `tabWater Quality Log`
WHERE
    hydroponic_system = %(hydroponic_system)s
    AND docstatus = 1
ORDER BY
    log_timestamp ASC
